code_name: Casa Grande City Code, Title 17 Zoning
edition: Current online edition as mirrored by Zoneomics (undated); amlegal 'latest' not directly readable
caveats: amlegal.com returned HTTP 403 to fetches; web.archive.org was blocked; casagrandeaz.gov/zoning-districts returned 404. All text was taken from the Zoneomics mirror of the code (https://www.zoneomics.com/code/casa-grande-AZ/chapter_N), a third-party copy; verify against amlegal before relying on it.

Table 17.16.030B (B-1..I-2 principal uses) was extracted with the column alignment lost: each row shows only how many of the six zone columns (B-1,B-2,B-3,B-4,I-1,I-2) carry a mark, not which. Per-zone principal-use assignments for B and I districts are therefore NOT confirmed except where cross-checked against each zone's own conditional-use list. Items flagged 'column unresolved' need checking on amlegal Table 17.16.030B.
Principal-use lists for residential zones (Table 17.16.030A) were not retrievable in detail; only a category summary was available.
Solar (utility-scale or otherwise) and heavy/hazardous manufacturing other than explosives were not found as named uses in anything retrieved; recorded as 'not addressed' in retrieved text.
The 'CR' suffix is not defined anywhere in the retrieved Title 17 text (zone list 17.16.010 has no CR). See cr_overlay_note.
Zone list 17.16.010 also includes SH Suburban Homestead and the Neighborhood Conservation District, not requested here.
cr_overlay_note: Could not be determined. Title 17 text retrieved (17.16.010 zone list, 17.16.030 tables, overlay mentions) contains no 'CR' designation; the only overlay in the zoning chapters is the PAD-RV (RV Park) overlay (Ch. 17.48) and a marijuana-dispensary overlay area (17.52.610). A web search found no definition either. 'CR' on the city GIS layer is likely a local GIS/ordinance-specific suffix (possibly a conditions/rezoning-case or similar qualifier) but this is unverified speculation; confirm with Casa Grande Planning & Development or the city GIS layer metadata.

districts.name: Planned Area Development Zone
districts.purpose: Alternative to conventional zoning that lets residential, commercial and industrial projects be designed as one integrated, unified development consistent with the general plan.
permitted_uses: Any use consistent with the general plan and the approved PAD guide (17.40.020.D)
Recreational vehicle parks per Ch. 17.48
Medical marijuana uses only if the PAD guide specifically permits them or the PAD primarily allows I-1/I-2 uses

standards.min_lot_size: Minimum PAD area 5 acres unless waived
standards.max_height: Not a fixed number; setback from adjacent property should approximately equal building height
standards.setbacks: Perimeter building setbacks at least 20 ft
standards.other: Open space 7%-15% of PAD; public or community water and sewer required; unified control; underground utilities generally; large retail standards in 17.40.020.S; 2021 Residential Design Standards for PADs adopted by reference (17.40.015)

districts.notes: Actual allowed uses, heights and lot standards come from each project's approved PAD guide, so industrial uses are possible in a PAD only if its guide says so. Site-specific lookup needed.

districts.name: Planned Area Development, Recreational Vehicle Park Overlay
districts.purpose: Allows RV parks at higher residential density with open space, as an economical, attractive and compatible use, ideally on arterial access.
permitted_uses: Recreational vehicles including park models

standards.min_lot_size: 10 acres gross; 1,500 sq ft minimum per space
standards.max_height: 30 ft (45 ft if at least 200 ft from any property line)
standards.setbacks: Perimeter wall 10 ft; front 10 ft; side 5 ft; rear 5 ft; corner side 10 ft; 10 ft between RVs
standards.other: Open space 7% of site or 150 sq ft per space, whichever greater; 6 ft decorative perimeter wall set back 20 ft from public streets; mobile homes prohibited; no exposed outdoor storage; accessory uses include management office, recreation, service buildings, park-user retail

districts.notes: Must be zoned PAD as well.

districts.name: Single-Family Residential
districts.purpose: Low-density single-family detached housing and directly related complementary uses, kept strictly residential.
permitted_uses: Per Table 17.16.030A: dwellings, parks, public/quasi-public buildings, commercial agricultural uses (category summary only; detailed per-zone list not retrieved)
conditional_uses: Per Table 17.16.030A category summary: schools, religious institutions, utility facilities, golf courses, day care (zone-specific list not retrieved)

standards.min_lot_size: 7,000 sq ft (70 ft x 100 ft); averaging allowed, none under 6,600 sq ft
standards.setbacks: Single-family: front 15 ft (20 ft to garage door/carport), side 5 ft with one side 10 ft, corner side 15 ft, rear 20 ft; other uses 20/10/20/20 ft; schools and civic/religious 50 ft

districts.notes: Lot coverage not specified in retrieved text.

districts.name: Commercial Office Zone
districts.purpose: Professional and business offices at a residential scale that buffer residential neighborhoods from more intense uses and busy roads.
permitted_uses: Professional, administrative and business offices
Banks and financial institutions
Medical, dental, chiropractic offices (not hospitals)
Photography, commercial arts and professional studios
Marijuana dispensaries within the 17.52.610 overlay area

standards.min_lot_size: Min width 150 ft; area set by building, parking, retention, landscaping and setbacks
standards.setbacks: Front 35 ft, rear 15 ft, side 15 ft, corner side 20 ft, residential boundary 30 ft
standards.other: All activity inside closed buildings; no outdoor display or storage; 6 ft decorative wall against residential; monument signs max 8 ft / 32 sq ft

districts.name: Neighborhood Business Zone
districts.purpose: Local centers with convenient retail or service outlets serving the surrounding neighborhood rather than the whole community.
permitted_uses: Principal uses per Table 17.16.030B (column assignment unresolved). Neighborhood-scale retail/service types in the table include offices, banks, barber/beauty, florist, bakery retail, small restaurants, general retail, laundromat, medical clinic; manufacturing, warehousing, trucking yard terminal, contractor storage yard and data centers are NOT listed in B-1's own sections and appear to be intended for B-4/I zones (inferred; verify)
Warehousing: not allowed by right per available evidence (verify)
Solar: not addressed
Heavy/hazardous manufacturing: not addressed (not allowed per B-1 purpose; verify)
conditional_uses: Bed and breakfast in historic district or landmark
Convenience store with more than four gas pumps

standards.min_lot_size: Min width 100 ft; area per building, parking and setbacks
standards.setbacks: Buildings: front 35 ft, interior side and rear 15 ft, corner side 15 ft, residential boundary 45 ft. Parking: front 4 ft, side/rear 3 ft, corner 4 ft, residential 3 ft
standards.other: Access only from arterial or specially designed streets; general landscaping per Chapters 17.52-17.64

districts.notes: Principal use list is only in Table 17.16.030B whose column alignment was lost. Data center, outdoor storage, trucking, manufacturing, solar: not confirmed for B-1; treat as not allowed unless verified.

districts.purpose: Low-intensity retail and service outlets at a community market scale on arterial streets.
permitted_uses: Principal uses per Table 17.16.030B (column assignment unresolved): community-scale retail, offices, restaurants, hotels/motels, banks, personal services, etc.
Manufacturing, warehousing, trucking yard terminal, truck stop: not confirmed for B-2 (rows exist in table with 1-3 columns marked; column unresolved)
Solar: not addressed
Heavy/hazardous manufacturing, explosives: not addressed in B-2 text
conditional_uses: Liquefied petroleum gas storage and dispensing

standards.setbacks: Buildings: front 35 ft, rear 15 ft, interior side aggregate 15 ft, corner 25 ft, residential boundary 45 ft. Parking: front 4, side/rear 3, corner 4, residential 3 ft
standards.other: Self-storage: buffer at least building height or 15 ft, tree per 30 ft, 6 ft block wall; arterial access

districts.name: Central Business Zone
districts.purpose: High-intensity retail and service outlets at a community market scale (downtown-style).
permitted_uses: Principal uses per Table 17.16.030B (column assignment unresolved): retail, offices, restaurants, hotels, personal services, etc.
Manufacturing, warehousing, trucking: not confirmed for B-3
Solar: not addressed
Heavy/hazardous manufacturing: not addressed

standards.max_height: No stated maximum; buildings over 35 ft need extra fire protection per fire chief
standards.setbacks: Buildings: 0 ft front/side/rear/corner; residential boundary 20 ft. Parking: front 4, side/rear 3, corner 4, residential 3 ft
standards.other: On-street parking may count toward requirements

districts.name: Community Services Zone
districts.purpose: Land-intensive retail, service or manufacturing operations in concentrated service areas with good public access, buffered from other uses and from arterial views.
permitted_uses: Principal uses per Table 17.16.030B (column assignment unresolved). Purpose text explicitly contemplates 'manufacturing operations'

Likely includes (table rows with few marked columns; column unresolved, verify): contractor storage yard, equipment rental/storage yard, building material yard, truck repair, trucking yard terminal, light manufacturing, warehousing, exterior storage screened from view, self-storage
Data center: CONDITIONAL (17.28.030.H)
Solar: not addressed
Heavy/hazardous manufacturing, explosives: not addressed

standards.min_lot_size: Min width 150 ft; area per building, parking, setbacks
standards.setbacks: Buildings: front 35 ft, rear 15 ft, interior side aggregate 15 ft, corner 25 ft, residential boundary 45 ft. Parking: front 4, side/rear 3, corner 4, residential 3 ft

permitted_uses: Principal uses per Table 17.16.030B (17.32.020); column assignment unresolved

Light manufacturing and limited warehousing (17.32.010 purpose explicitly says 'light manufacturing uses and warehousing'); table rows 'Manufacturing, light' and 'Warehousing' exist, column unresolved
Data center: CONDITIONAL (17.32.030.G)
Heavy manufacturing / explosives / chemicals: not listed among I-1 conditional uses; explosives appear only as conditional in I-2 (so likely not allowed in I-1; verify)
Solar: not addressed
Trucking terminal, outdoor storage: table rows exist (trucking yard terminal marked in 2 columns; exterior storage screened marked in 3 columns) but I-1 column unresolved

standards.min_lot_size: Min width 100 ft; area per building, parking, setbacks
standards.setbacks: Buildings: front 35 ft, interior side/rear 15 ft, corner 30 ft, residential boundary 45 ft. Parking: front 4, side/rear 3, corner 4, residential 3 ft

districts.name: General Industrial Zone
districts.purpose: Industries whose operation, appearance, traffic or emissions make them incompatible with other zones but which the city considers necessary and desirable.
permitted_uses: Principal uses per Table 17.16.030B (17.36.020); column assignment unresolved. Table includes (marked in 1-3 of the six columns, so apply to I-2 and/or I-1/B-4; unresolved): manufacturing, light manufacturing, warehousing, bottling plant, fertilizer manufacture (subject to Ch. 17.58), food processing, trucking yard terminal, truck repair, truck stop, truck washing, contractor storage yard, equipment rental/storage yard, impound yard, recycling center, building material yard, exterior storage screened from view, grain elevator, battery storage with S occupancy
Data center: CONDITIONAL (17.36.030.I)
Explosives / volatile or explosive materials manufacture or storage: CONDITIONAL (17.36.030.S)
Battery storage with H occupancy: CONDITIONAL

Oil refineries, meat packing, fiberglass manufacturing, sewage treatment, auto dismantling/junk and salvage yards, scrap metal processing, excavation, airports, heliports, racetracks, railroad switching yards: CONDITIONAL
Production/testing/processing of goods not otherwise permitted: CONDITIONAL (17.36.030.B)
Solar: not addressed
conditional_uses: Production, testing or processing of goods not permitted in Table 17.16.030B
Auto dismantling, junk and salvage yards
Excavation of sand, gravel, dirt, ore, minerals
Scrap metal/used materials processing and storage (not recycling centers)
Uses involving storage, use or manufacture of volatile or explosive materials

standards.min_lot_size: Min width 100 ft; area per building, parking, setbacks
standards.max_height: 60 ft; up to 75 ft if building setbacks increase 3 ft per 1 ft over 60, street landscaping depth +10 ft, and design fits area
standards.setbacks: Buildings: front 35 ft, interior side/rear 15 ft, corner 30 ft, residential boundary 75 ft. Parking: front 4, side/rear 3, corner 4, residential 3 ft
standards.other: Arterial or industrial-designed street access; Ch. 17.58 storage rules (6 ft opaque screening; bulk flammable/chemical storage per fire code; hazardous waste per ADHS); floodplain Ch. 15.40

districts.notes: Most intensive zone in the city. Same Table 17.16.030B column limitation as I-1; verify by-right manufacturing/warehousing/outdoor storage/trucking on amlegal.
